userStories.title: Bounded differ, adapter move, presentation contract
userStories.description: As a web-platform engineer, I want a pure bounded/memoized line-diff module, the git-hunk adapter moved into lib/, and tool-presentation exposing diff badges/facts/body data, so that both renderers consume one safe, tested data contract without any React or provider changes.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/package.json and bun.lock pin exact "diff": "9.0.0"; the only production module importing or calling structuredPatch is packages/web/src/lib/diff-hunks.ts.

diff-hunks.ts exports MAX_DIFF_SIDE_BYTES=65536, MAX_DIFF_SIDE_LINES=2000, MAX_DIFF_EDIT_LENGTH=2000, DIFF_CONTEXT_LINES=4, DIFF_MEMO_ENTRIES=256, DIFF_MEMO_SOURCE_CODE_UNITS=1048576, DiffHunksResult, DiffHunksFn, createDiffHunks factory (injectable memoEntries/memoSourceCodeUnits/patch/byteLength, positive-finite-integer validation that fails fast), and the diffHunks singleton.

Bounds behave per contract: .length over byte cap returns null uncached; miss path measures UTF-8 via injected byteLength/shared TextEncoder; logical line counting without split (0 for '', newlines+1 when no trailing \n, stop at limit+1); structuredPatch('','',before,after,'','',{context:4,maxEditLength:2000}) with no timeout/normalization options; undefined or thrown patch results cache null; LRU refresh on hit and eviction until both entry-count and source-weight budgets hold; every computed result cached.

Hunk conversion: counters start at hunk oldStart/newStart; ' '→normal advances both, '-'→delete advances old, '+'→insert advances new; any '\\' entry skipped without advancing (may repeat mid-array); jsdiff hunk/change order preserved; deterministic '@@ -oldStart,oldLines +newStart,newLines @@' header set for later-hunk decoration.

Display safety: line content passes sanitizeBounded(...,1024), then Cf format controls and U+2028/U+2029 are escaped as uppercase ASCII \u{HEX} via a bounded code-point accumulator; ellipsis fits inside the 1024 ceiling; diffing uses raw strings and Raw keeps the original payload.

git-hunk-adapter.ts and its test move to packages/web/src/lib/, use generated types from @/lib/api.generated (not runtime @/lib/api); virtualized-diff.tsx updates only its import; all source-control tests still pass.

tool-presentation.ts: local fileEditPair(record) uses existing hasOwn on BEFORE_AFTER_PAIRS keys, requires both values strings ('' valid), runs only after family resolves to 'file', reads inside try/catch (throwing accessor = non-qualifying); module-level WeakMap<object, DiffHunksResult|null> with fileDiffFor(record) used by both summary and file body arm; exports type FileDiff = DiffHunksResult; ToolRowBadgeKind gains 'diff'; ToolRowBadgeTone gains 'success'; file body arm gains diff: FileDiff | null.

Nonempty diff: '+n' badge only when added>0 (kind diff, tone success), '−m' only when deleted>0 (tone danger); body facts 'N hunk'/'N hunks' then 'replace_all: true|false' only when own input is boolean; identical pair yields 'no changes' fact, no badges; refusal/no pair preserves today's fallback with no badges/facts; body facts compose for all families; diff badges excluded from the body bar; non-file outputs unchanged; existing strict file-body expectations gain diff: null.
Both renderer tone maps (NodeRoom.tsx, ConsoleAgentHistoryList.tsx) gain exhaustive success: { className: 'text-success' } entries so the package type-checks; no other JSX changes in this story.

All new tests written first and green: byte/line/edit-length bound and limit+1 cases (incl. multibyte under code-unit precheck over UTF-8, 2000/2001 lines, 1000/1001 disjoint edit lengths, injected undefined), thrown patch caching, empty-to-content/deletion-to-empty/identical/repeated/CRLF cases, mid-array and doubled no-newline markers with all-positive line numbers accepted by toHunkData, ANSI/C0/C1/bidi/zero-width/BOM/U+2028-9 escaping within 1024, LRU hit/refresh/count-eviction/weight-eviction, plus the tool-presentation contract tests (qualification, badges, facts, no-changes, fallback, WeakMap single-differ-call, pair-LRU reuse across records, unchanged non-file/Raw).

Owning docs updated: CAP-5, Story 1.4, tool-presentation-contract.md, and test-plan.md describe shipped behavior — gate resolution, pair qualification, deterministic caps, dual-bounded memoization, snippet-relative numbering, no-newline handling, visible control escaping, identical/refusal semantics, failed-output behavior, later-hunk separator rule — with no phase numbers, audit labels, or plan finding IDs.

Commands green: cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/diff-hunks.test.ts src/lib/git-hunk-adapter.test.ts src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts; NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/source-control/; bun run type-check; bun run lint; bun run format:check.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-01-start.md exactly (contracts, test list, implementation order 2-8). Key anchors: tool-presentation.ts inferFamily :460, BEFORE_AFTER_PAIRS :142, hasOwn :232, toolRowPresentation :748; sanitizeBounded at tool-output.ts:191; adapter currently at packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/git-hunk-adapter.ts. CRLF is raw-compared so LF/CRLF rewrites may show changed rows with equal visible text — cover and document it. No provider-name branches or prose parsing. Export FileDiff from tool-presentation so Phase 2 renderers never import the differ.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 3. userStories.title: Inline diff on Legacy and Console
userStories.description: As an operator, I want expanded file-edit rows on both Legacy and Console to render the bounded unified diff inline with required success/error treatments, so that I can read the change without opening Raw while every non-qualified row keeps its existing fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Each renderer (Legacy NodeRoom.tsx, Console ConsoleAgentHistoryList.tsx) imports values from react-diff-view/esm/index.js, types from react-diff-view, the package stylesheet, toHunkData from @/lib/git-hunk-adapter, and the FileDiff type from @/lib/tool-presentation; neither imports 'diff' nor '@/lib/diff-hunks'; no shared React component is created.

File body states in both surfaces: path first with text-node-command and overflow-wrap:anywhere; diff!==null&&hunks.length>0 renders InlineDiff; diff!==null&&hunks.length===0 renders secondary 'no changes'; diff===null renders the unchanged semantic fallback (unreadable message / 'no preview' / preview); a valid diff on a non-succeeded outcome with a preview or unreadable state renders a second inset box with the normalized output; success keeps provider prose behind Raw only.

InlineDiff: each hunk converted via toHunkData; <Diff diffType="modify" viewType="unified" className="tool-diff">; first hunk direct; before every later hunk a text-only Decoration with the synthesized '@@ ... @@' header; local renderGutter shows one-char marker + right-aligned number ('+'/insert number, '−' U+2212/delete number, blank marker + old context number), returns null for the new gutter; '+ '/'−' remain exposed to assistive technology; no anchors, tokens, highlighting, virtualization, split view, or focusable controls.

index.css gains one scoped .tool-diff block: surface/ring token mapping, inset surface mixed with success/error at restrained tint for row backgrounds, success-colored inserted code+markers, error-colored deleted code+markers, primary context code, --text-secondary right-aligned numbers in a fixed 3ch area plus one marker char, hidden second gutter column verified against rendered v3.3.3 DOM, width:100% fixed layout, white-space:pre-wrap, overflow-wrap:anywhere, no room-level horizontal scrolling, secondary noninteractive decoration text, and local foreground custom properties for insert/delete states starting from var(--success)/var(--error) so contrast correction stays one scoped change.

Tests written first and green — Legacy static (NodeRoom.test.tsx): path first, .tool-diff, jsdiff-order cells (context, two deletes, two inserts, context), −/+ markers, snippet numbers 1-4, no decoration on one hunk, no success prose, no serialized old_string JSON; '+2' success badge, '−2' danger badge, 'file · 1 hunk · replace_all: false' with counts absent from the bar; failed row shows same table plus normalized error in second box; multi-hunk row shows one decoration with expected header; identical row shows 'file · no changes' + explicit 'no changes'; one-sided Write, generic no-input edit, and refused pair keep unchanged path-plus-preview fallback; malicious-control fixture yields expected visible escapes and exactly one DOM row per change.

Legacy interaction (LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx): opening mounts the table; Raw replaces it with the original payload incl. unsanitized source; toggling back restores the safe table; keyboard order stays summary → Raw → existing controls with no diff tab stop.

Console (ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx + ConsoleExecutionHistory.test.tsx): same anatomy/state/Raw assertions in the room host and the inline-history host, catching divergence between Console mounting paths.

Boundary tests (src/lib/diff-boundary.test.ts + console-isolation.test.ts): '@/lib/git-hunk-adapter' added to Console's approved set with a comment that it is the pure conversion shared with source control; production src/**/*.{ts,tsx} scan proves only lib/diff-hunks.ts contains structuredPatch; both renderers import neither 'diff' nor '@/lib/diff-hunks'; moved adapter imports generated types from '@/lib/api.generated' not runtime '@/lib/api'; Console third-party diff imports limited to the proven v3.3.3 runtime/type/style specifiers.

No component test timeout widened; focused legs, full bun --filter @archon/web test, type-check, lint, format:check all green; stable browser hooks kept for Phase 3: .tool-diff, .tool-diff-marker, .tool-diff-line-number, .diff-code-insert, .diff-code-delete, .diff-code-normal, .diff-decoration, and exact '+2'/'−2' badge text.
No contrast assertions attempted in happy-dom (browser-only measurement lands in US-004).
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-02-two-surface-renderers.md. Re-check both ToolBodySwitch call sites and memo deps before editing; reuse virtualized-diff.tsx import specifiers exactly; add only the pure adapter to console-isolation approved set (:115-133). Fallback may gain block wrappers for valid table layout but text/order/tones/behavior unchanged. Fixture order asserted must be jsdiff's (context, deletes, inserts), not the mockup's alternating illustration. If test duration looks suspicious use --reporter=junit before touching timeouts.

userStories.title: Deterministic full-stack proof and closeout
userStories.description: As a release engineer, I want deterministic e2e fake-provider file-edit variants, a four-node fixture, Playwright evidence on both surfaces across required widths/themes with measured contrast, and full validation, so that Story 1.4 closes with recorded proof and no Codex overclaim.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/e2e-fake/provider.ts scenarioSchema gains fileEdit: z.enum(['edit','failed','write','bare']).optional(), mutually exclusive with emitTool, emitTodo, askHuman, doneWhenPromptIncludes, repeatTool, largeLastToolOutput, taskDispatch, echoPrompt in the existing refinement/error style (delayMs may coexist); pinned exported constants E2E_FAKE_EDIT_* / E2E_FAKE_WRITE_* / E2E_FAKE_BARE_EDIT_* per phase-03 (Edit tool, crates/gigo-harness-worker/src/auto_retry.rs backoff fixture, replace_all:false, success/failure outputs, Write one-sided input, bare 'edit' with no toolInput).

Each variant emits one paired successful call/result with cloned object inputs: edit=two-sided success; failed=same input + 'String to replace not found in file.' + toolOutcome 'error'; write=one-sided Write; bare=generic 'edit' with absent (not undefined) toolInput; existing assistant lead-in retained; provider tests assert exact event order, tool names, paired ids/results, input shapes, absent bare toolInput, and every exclusivity rejection — green via bun --filter @archon/providers test.

e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-file-edit.yaml created with mutates_checkout:false and four chained e2e-fake nodes for the variants; e2e/lib/playwright/archon-runtime.ts registers/copies it and adds typed runFileEditWorkflow() on the existing CLI runner.

e2e/ui/file-edit-diff.spec.ts titles prefixed '[P1] file-edit:'; on both surfaces asserts: summary '+2' and U+2212 '−2', body bar 'file · 1 hunk · replace_all: false'; open body has path first, one .tool-diff, two delete/two insert/two context cells in jsdiff order, delete text contains min(31) and secs + 1, insert text contains min(30) and secs, markers and numbers 1-4, no decoration; success prose absent from normalized body; Raw removes the table and shows original old_string, closing restores it; failed edit initially open with same diff plus failure text in second inset box; Write row keeps path+preview with no badge/table; bare row labeled 'generic no-input fallback' shows chip/path 'edit' + preview, no fabricated diff; no request leaves the app origin during open/toggle.

Viewport/theme matrix executed and captured per surface: 1440×1000 at reference width (Legacy 460px, Console 520px) both themes; forced shared 460px with geometry assertions; 390×844 both themes; failed edit + one-sided/bare fallbacks captured at reference width both themes; identical/refused/multi-hunk/malicious-control states linked as component evidence in the acceptance table (no extra browser fixtures unless browser-specific behavior requires them).

At every tested width: room/panel/body have no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 2); summary stays one visual line preserving chip/status/duration/counts/chevron; table inner width matches body content within 2px; long code wraps inside cells; marker + fixed 3ch number area readable without consuming the code column; design-spine states match.

Accessibility: native details/summary relationship retained, diff has no focusable descendant, tab from summary/Raw reaches the existing next control; measured computed foreground/background ≥4.5:1 for +2/−2 badges at rest and hover, inserted code+marker, deleted code+marker, line numbers on normal/insert/delete gutters, and normal context code — on both surfaces and themes; any failing insert/delete foreground is mixed toward --text-primary via the scoped variable and the full matrix re-measured (floor never lowered, signs never removed).

reports/implementation-evidence.md records the resolved product-gate choice, commands, focused/full test results, and links; reports/visual-acceptance.md plus reports/captures/ cover the state×surface×viewport×theme matrix, every measured ratio with resolved colors, the mockup-side-by-side, and the two explained deviations (snippet-relative numbering, grouped jsdiff ordering); the bare row is called 'generic no-input fallback' in tests and reports, never Codex.

Full validation green in order: bun --filter @archon/providers test; packages/web lib + components + console legs; bun --filter @archon/web test; bun run --cwd e2e typecheck; bun run --cwd e2e test:ui -- --grep 'file-edit'; bun run --cwd e2e test:ui:hitl; bun run validate. Root bun test never run; no second dev server started when the e2e harness owns one.

Closeout: Story 1.4/CAP-5 re-read line by line and every retained acceptance clause mapped to evidence; only then _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/agent-node-room/sprint-status.yaml set to 1-4-view-a-file-edit-as-an-inline-diff: done with its normal timestamp; PR opened from the repository template with 'Closes #177', owning contract docs under Review guidance, and evidence under Validation. If any acceptance item lacks evidence, stop before sprint-status and PR.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-03-verification-and-closeout.md. Reuse room-opening, panel-resize, capture, color-resolution, contrast, and request-listener helpers from e2e/ui/task-dispatch-body.spec.ts and adjacent room specs. Failure handling per plan: one-surface failure → fix local renderer + retain component assertion; wrong counts/order → inspect Phase 1 conversion, never massage DOM order; contrast → scoped mix + remeasure; overflow → scoped table/gutter/code rules, no panel scrollbar or new breakpoint; near-5s tests → JUnit timings, no timeout raises. e2e stays standalone (bun run --cwd e2e ...).
